# 901 — A todo title is stored without leading and trailing spaces

## Problem

A title typed with stray spaces ("  Buy milk  ") should be stored as "Buy milk". Create already does this; this spec pins it with an acceptance test.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC-901.1** Given a create request body whose title has leading or trailing spaces, such as `{"title": "  Buy milk  "}`, when the body is parsed, then the title is `"Buy milk"`.

## Open questions

- None.

"""Acceptance test for spec 901. It names its criterion AC-901.1."""

from __future__ import annotations

from todo_api.todos.validation import parse_create
